title: Tommy Tutone - 867-5309/Jenny (Official Video)
summary: The official music video for Tommy Tutone's 1981 hit 867-5309/Jenny. The chorus is built around a phone number.
why: HN links it to explain the cultural reference when 867-5309 shows up as a stand-in phone number.
